task: Implement the clean waving character sprite animation in a React app using CSS Modules.

asset.note: This version uses only the 10 original normalized frames. No AI/optical-flow interpolation is used, so there are no phantom or ghost arms.

implementation.behavior: Play the wave once on hover.
requirements: Use the sprite sheet as a CSS background image.
The visible element is exactly one frame: 400px wide by 450px tall.
Use discrete sprite steps, not smooth CSS interpolation.
Start around 0.8 to 1.0 seconds for the full animation and tune by eye.
Do not use opacity fades or crossfades between frames.
Do not add motion blur, frame blending, or ghosting.

acceptanceCriteria: Only one arm is visible in every frame.
There is no phantom arm or motion-trail effect.
The character remains aligned in place while waving.
The animation plays through the 10 clean frames in order.
The sprite snaps between discrete frames rather than crossfading.
